<!-- pr-reviewer: a772b1b166fe0ca82f78035bd34e8bc726b9e21e -->
**Verdict: Ready for the maintainer to merge.**

**What looks good**
- No `build.rs`, `.github`, scripts or dependency changes, so it was built and tested in full.
- Posted output is changed only where the PR says. A stated `safe_retract` posts `G53 G0 Z<v>`. A Tormach-named machine, or no machine, keeps `G53 G0 Z0` + `G30`. Every shipped Tormach `.mch` plus `vmc`, `tilthead` and `3axis-vmc` state `0.0`, so their output is byte-identical. The goldens are untouched and `conformance` passes byte-exact.
- Only `lathe.mch` and `millturn.mch` state nothing. They are refused by name through the Tormach post (`tormach.cps` `safeZ()`), not guessed, which fits the Prime Directive. Every other post ignores the new `safeRetractZ` / `model` keys, so no other machine's output changes.
- The parser refuses a garbled or misplaced `safe_retract` and names the axis (`parse.rs` `safe_retract`). Zero counts as stated. The raw door and the mirror both scale units.
- No `unwrap` or `expect` on new paths. Provenance comment and decision file are present. The body ends `Fixes #495` and has a `Changelog:` line. The PR does not edit `CHANGELOG.md`.

**Local results (PR head merged with current upstream/main; the merge was clean)**

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `camcraft-post` (all) | pass |
| `tormach_safe_retract` | 4 passed |
| `tormach_post` | 10 passed |
| `tormach_machines` | 5 passed |
| `machine` | 32 passed |
| `machine_library` | 11 passed |
| `posting` | 17 passed |
| `conformance` | 6 passed |
| `fanuc_post` | 11 passed |
| `inverted_post` | 15 passed |
| `program_comments` | 4 passed |
| `wear_comp` | 5 passed |
| `control_comp` | 5 passed |
| `setup_mount` | 6 passed |
| `setup_carry` | 9 passed |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-post -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |

**Requested before merge**
None.

**Questions / notes (not blocking)**
- Dropping `G30` when the stated safe Z is non-zero and the older-document refusal are both judgement calls already recorded in `docs/decisions/495-safe-retract.md`. Both look reasonable. The refusal is visible and cannot gouge.
- `tormach.cps` is 453 lines. Post scripts are exempt from the 400-line rule.
- No real cut or Hub sim was run, as the PR states. The Tormach output is unchanged, so none is needed there.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
